title: Russia Hammers Kyiv With Missiles as Ukraine Hits Oil Facilities
summary: Russian forces strafed Ukraine’s capital with a major missile barrage overnight, killing at least three people and causing widespread power outages, as the US ramps up pressure on President Volodymyr Zelenskiy to agree to concessions in the almost four-year-old war.
